This page documents **Figure 8b**. The other panels of Figure 8 are produced by
the RQVI framework and are documented in the
[companion repository for RQVI](https://github.com/TianzeCompbio/RQVI_GP_figures/tree/main).

Each of the 200 EBMF GPs is compared with a matched RQVI GP -- RQVI being an
alternative factorization of the same cells, run across 10 random-seed
initializations (256 GPs per seed). In the code and the intermediate files the
EBMF GPs are named F1-F200; those are GP1-GP200.

## Figure 8b {#fig8b}

```{r fig8b-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/Figure8/8B.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 8b.** Cluster-level activity profiles of corresponding EBMF and RQVI
GPs. EBMF cell loadings (left) and matched RQVI program loadings (right) were
averaged within the 107 level-2 clusters.
:::

## How the figure is made

Three steps, run from the repository root:

```{.bash .fold-none}
Rscript script/Figure8b.R          # cluster-mean matrices + column/palette metadata
python  script/Figure8b_rematch.py # one-to-one EBMF-RQVI program matching
python  script/Figure8b_plot.py    # heatmaps
```

The Python steps require `matplotlib`, `pandas`, `scipy`, `h5py` and `numpy`.
The RQVI cell-level loadings are read from `data/`, a git-ignored symlink that
is not tracked here.

### Cluster means

```{r fig8b-data, code=readLines("../script/Figure8b.R"), eval=FALSE}
```

### Matching

A maximum-weight one-to-one assignment matches each EBMF GP to a distinct RQVI
GP. The median per-GP correlation is 0.766, with 92.5% at r >= 0.5. Code:
[`script/Figure8b_rematch.py`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/blob/main/script/Figure8b_rematch.py).
